notes: carBox: re-measured on a 12x pixel ruler (tail light x76, nose x323, spoiler top y478, tyre bottoms y564); the eyeballed box clipped the nose and the tyres; segModel birefnet-general (the lite model followed the blister on the other cars)
wheels: traced on the ruler (rim rings r~16, tyres r~22, both cy 542); auto-detection found only the rims, which put the ground 5 px too high

model.rebake.glass: only the windscreen is a surface on this mesh - the side, quarter and rear-hatch windows are open holes (clay renders show the seats through them), so side/left/rear are left out. Windscreen traced on the mesh's own panel in front (inside the A-pillars, below the roof lip at y1188, above the cowl line at y1270; the sheet mask ran up onto the roof lip) and top (Tripo's grey panel inside its dark cowl band); both on one half, mirrored

model.rebake.skip top: the rear seat backs and the hatch-opening frame sit where the top drawing has its spoiler and red-interior rear window (the hatch glass is an open hole on this mesh), so the top view painted the seats gold and the frame lip red; the top view no longer paints inside the opening's outer edge (Tripo's red seats / black frame or the rear drawing win)
mask.remove: the segmenter took 2 px of the blister's edge past the front bumper (the bumper's shaded end is x324 on a 14x ruler); trimmed at x325

model.fit width 0.983: after the sheet fit the body was 1.7-2% wider than the front and rear drawings (cyan bands down both flanks of silhouette-front/rear) and the top body width 1.017; 0.983 brings front 1.000, rear 1.005, top 1.000 and raises front/rear IoU 0.949/0.933 -> 0.955/0.943. The red left on the greenhouse in front/rear is the mesh's narrower cabin (shape), not size

model.rebake.skip top (cowl): the top drawing's windscreen is longer than the mesh's, so it painted its thick black frame and red interior onto the mesh's cowl/hood edge as a wavy dark band (lopsided by the alignment); the top view no longer paints a curved strip ahead of the traced windscreen, just past the drawn frame (a straight cut left a visible seam across the hood), so the front drawing / Tripo's gold cowl with its thin dark line show

width vs the front/rear drawings: the sheet disagrees with itself - calibrate reports front_aspect_mismatch +23% and rear +24% (the front/rear views draw the car that much wider for their height than the side+top views do). The model is sized to side+top (the gated proportions); a fit of width 1.21 matching the front/rear drawings was tried, looked squat, failed the 5% top-width gate and doubled the hood badge, so it was not kept
